Let's sketch the trajectory.

- We start at the given point and go along with the flow (downward and slightly to the left) until the trajectory intersects the $y$-nullcline, where the tangents are horizontal.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14073694/assets/38cdd84fa7383122a41e287efe71822acc0ea6ffc7beb6567fe31e461e7b2bc2.png)

- Next, the flow continues going to the left but then starts turning upward.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14073694/assets/8861a2e90a1bf87651157b0eba1e38363f646c2305724a254498173fd47c554c.png)

- After that, the trajectory continues slightly to the left and upward, suggesting that it may converge to the origin.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14073694/assets/a7c5a4702b6add4085b594d6e6cebd85b4746ef8138f22089679c5277266aa59.png)

Let's sketch the trajectory.

  • We start at the given point and go along with the flow (downward and slightly to the left) until the trajectory intersects the y-nullcline, where the tangents are horizontal.
  • Next, the flow continues going to the left but then starts turning upward.
  • After that, the trajectory continues slightly to the left and upward, suggesting that it may converge to the origin.
